banner.title: alertmanager
banner.tagline: Routes every Prometheus alert to Pushover by severity, and pings Healthchecks.io while the Watchdog fires.

explainer.title: From a firing rule to a phone that rings only when it should

steps.title: Secret
steps.text: ExternalSecret alertmanager-secret pulls the Pushover token and user key, and the Healthchecks ping URL, from 1Password.
steps.scene: a key emerging from a vault

steps.title: Route
steps.text: Prometheus posts each alert here. The root route groups by alertname and namespace, then picks a receiver by severity.
steps.scene: a branching railway track with switches

steps.title: Page
steps.text: Critical sounds the Pushover siren at priority 2 until it is acknowledged or 30 minutes pass. Warning is audible. Info stays silent.
steps.scene: a rotating siren beacon on a desk

steps.title: Heartbeat
steps.text: The Watchdog alert always fires. Each firing ping reaches Healthchecks.io every 5 minutes; a missed ping is the dead-man signal.
steps.scene: a heartbeat trace on a monitor

steps.title: Inhibit
steps.text: The inhibit rules mute info alerts while a warning or critical fires in the same namespace. InfoInhibitor covers the case where no warning is firing.
steps.scene: a bell with a slash over a stack of cards
